name: build-targets
title: Build targets: choose Windows, Linux, Android, iOS or web in the editor and build, with private console targets later (eleven stages)
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Split into one item per stage (bt1..bt11) before launching.
acceptance: The editor lists the targets, shows what each one needs, builds any target the machine can build, and runs it on a device for device targets
One command line (n2build) does the same for CI and people
A console target can be added from outside the repository
Existing targets keep their behaviour, tests, smoke runs and size budgets at every stage
The editor can pick and build the targets that already work (Windows, Linux, web) after stage 3, before any platform-layer change
gate: split per stage; every stage needs the user's go; decisions D1, D3, D4 before stage 1, the rest before the stage that needs them
notes: Reviewer: no behaviour change on existing targets, platform code only behind the platform layer, no signing secret in the project, host, logs or protocol.
